rule.statement: The petitioners are entitled to the reliefs prayed for by issuance of Writs of Certiorari and Prohibition.
rule.supporting_quote: The petitioners of CA Writ Application Nos. 98/2012 are entitled to the reliefs prayed for in paragraphs (c) and (d) of the prayer to the petition dated 01.04.2012 by issuance of Writs of Certiorari and Prohibition quashing and implementing the Field Staff Circular No. 05/2011 dated 25.11.2011.
